problem: Scene file selection could update a closed or destroyed action editor. An accepted action editor could then update a closed or destroyed Rules table.
change: Check Qt validity and visibility at each modal boundary; delete the child action editor only when it still exists.

reproduction.cases: Scene load and start file pickers after rejection or destruction; accepted target editor after Rules rejection or destruction.
reproduction.observed: Closed fields changed or deleted QLineEdit/QTableWidget access raised RuntimeError.

coverage: Six closure cases ignore results and refuse subsequent modal entry.
Scene load and start pickers preserve values on cancellation and accept a new file after reopening.
Target cancellation preserves the rule; reopening and accepting updates only its target value, preserving screen selection, identity, conditions, priority and cooldown.
Existing scene execution ordering, diagnostics, save failure and runtime ownership checks pass.

limitations: Offscreen Qt tests substitute file-picker results and the child editor exec loop.
Full regression, independent review and integration remain pending. Native evidence does not cover OS keyboard input or the real file picker.

keyboard_fix.problem: Tab cycled through table cells and could not reach the target button.
keyboard_fix.red_result: 1 failed, 20 deselected in 2.00s; target button did not receive focus.
keyboard_fix.change: Set table.setTabKeyNavigation(False). Arrow keys retain cell navigation.
keyboard_fix.verification: Tab reaches target controls without changing rules, and Right moves to the next cell.

native.platform: Windows private desktop, Traditional_Chinese, dark, 900x740 main window
native.entry: Actual settings_menu._open_dialog with RulesDialog and real nested SceneActionDialog.exec; widget-local Tab/Space on target, browse and confirmation buttons. File picker returns substituted.
